description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing weekend with Maria.

How would you like me to help with this? I can:
- Draft/send an email sharing the trip with friends or family
- Reply to or forward a message (e.g., send photos to Maria or others)
- Create a short social-style message you can paste into a post
- Save a draft/notes about the trip

If you want an email, pick one of these or tell me the recipient and tone, and I’ll prepare it:

1) Quick update to friends
Subject: Weekend in the countryside
Body:
Hi everyone —
Just got back from a relaxing weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria. We spent our time exploring nature trails, breathing in fresh air, and recharging. I’ll share photos soon!
— [Your name]

2) Personal note to family
Subject: Lovely weekend with Maria
Body:
Hi all —
Maria and I took a short weekend trip to the countryside. We hiked some peaceful trails, enjoyed the fresh air, and had a really nice, low-key time together. Feeling refreshed — thought you’d like to know.
Love,
[Your name]

3) Short note with photos to share
Subject: Photos from my weekend trip
Body:
Hi [Name] —
Spent the weekend in the countryside with Maria — beautiful trails and lots of fresh air. Attaching a few photos from the trip. Hope you enjoy them!
Best,
[Your name]

Tell me which template to use (or paste your own), who to send it to, and whether to send now or save as a draft. I’ll take care of it.
